title: Multimodal Capability Fabric
decision_gates: Clinical interpretation of images, waveforms, or audio
Remote code, restrictive licences, network model downloads, or external inference
Promotion of a research-only capability into operational use
description: Define a replaceable capability fabric for OCR and layout, encoders, speech transcription and diarisation, medical images and DICOM, and ECG or time-series data, with explicit limits, privacy behaviour, and governance status.
